# Lab and Network OS Command Reference

These are starting points for inspection. Syntax and available features depend on the image and version; consult the image documentation before changing a configuration. Commands prefixed with `sudo` modify or inspect the local host and may require privileges.

## Containerlab and netlab

```sh
sudo containerlab deploy -t topology.clab.yml
sudo containerlab inspect -t topology.clab.yml
sudo containerlab destroy -t topology.clab.yml
netlab up
netlab status
netlab down
```

Use these in the directory containing the relevant topology. Destroy/down removes the running lab; preserve configurations and evidence first.

## Linux and FRR

```sh
ip -br link
ip -br address
ip route show
ip -6 route show
ip neigh show
ss -tulpn
sudo tcpdump -ni eth1
sudo vtysh -c 'show ip route'
sudo vtysh -c 'show ip ospf neighbor'
sudo vtysh -c 'show bgp summary'
```

## Arista EOS

At the EOS CLI, inspect with `show interfaces status`, `show vlan`, `show ip route`, `show ip ospf neighbor`, and `show ip bgp summary`. Configuration begins with `configure terminal`; save intentional changes with `write memory` when appropriate for the lab.

## Nokia SR Linux

At the SR Linux CLI, inspect with `show interface`, `show network-instance default route-table ipv4-unicast`, and `show network-instance default protocols bgp neighbor`. Use the actual network-instance name in place of `default`. Enter candidate configuration with `enter candidate`, inspect changes, and use `commit now` to apply them; verify syntax against the image version.

## Compare a task

| Task | Linux / FRR | Arista EOS | Nokia SR Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interfaces | `ip -br link` | `show interfaces status` | `show interface` |
| IPv4 routes | `show ip route` in vtysh | `show ip route` | `show network-instance default route-table ipv4-unicast` |
| BGP peers | `show bgp summary` in vtysh | `show ip bgp summary` | `show network-instance default protocols bgp neighbor` |

Capture output before and after a change so that the observed behavior can be compared with the topology and expected result.

## Common checks and evidence

| Question | FRR / Linux | Arista EOS | SR Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| What addresses are present? | `ip -br address` | `show ip interface brief` | `show interface` |
| Which IPv4 neighbors are resolved? | `ip neigh show` | `show arp` | `show network-instance default neighbor` |
| Is the BGP session established? | `show bgp summary` in vtysh | `show ip bgp summary` | `show network-instance default protocols bgp neighbor` |

A command's output is evidence at one instant. Compare the expected prefix, next hop, interface, and neighbor state with the diagram and the lab's addressing plan. Take a capture at each end of a suspect link when the tables do not explain the failure. Use the network instance and address family configured in the lab; examples above use the default instance.
